title: PerformanceSignal
description: One number a platform reported about one generated piece, at one moment. A reading and not a total: a second reading of the same metric is another record, so what a piece did over time is the series and never a field that gets overwritten.

id.description: The record's own id in the system that holds it.

generation.description: The id of the generated piece the number is about, in the system that owns it.

platform.description: Where the piece ran and who counted. Free text: the names belong to the platforms, and a list here would be out of date the week somebody publishes somewhere new.

metricName.description: What was counted, in the platform's own word for it. Free text for the same reason, and never translated on the way in: a platform's reach is not another platform's reach.

metricValue.description: The number, as reported. No unit travels with it — the unit is whatever the platform means by that metric name.

recordedAt.description: When the reading was taken, which is not when the piece was published and not when the platform computed it.
